provenance: Derived mechanics only from 10 locally authorised Tech Roast / Austin Nasso transcript files. No source dialogue is stored here or supplied to the model.
mechanics: Cold-open on the target, their claim, or an awkwardly specific detail. Do not warm up the room.
Treat the subject's own description as the setup, then reframe it in plain language.
Escalate by changing the angle, not by repeating a synonym for bad.
Use short reaction beats after a turn when they sharpen the contrast. Do not explain the reaction.
Exit immediately after the strongest concrete word or callback. Never add a moral, summary, or recovery sentence.

scriptRecipe.shape: 3-4 sentences. Sentence one opens with the target. Each later sentence introduces a fresh turn. The final sentence is the callback or hardest hit.
scriptRecipe.voice: Fast, conversational, observant, and unbothered. Original material only; never quote, imitate, or identify any source performer.
